title: MEAF Policy Bundle
description: Cross-object conformance and gate rules that JSON Schema alone cannot enforce (manuscript appendix A.4). The policy bundle is the only place where an organisation's risk choices live; the validator and gate read them as data.

approved-evidence-methods.description: Evidence collected by a method outside this list is an L4 error. An empty list declares that no method policy is in force, which raises one L4 warning rather than silently passing.

interruption-requirements.description: Per attack-path impact tier, the interruption types that must be present before the harmful outcome and for recovery.

require-before-outcome.description: At least one control on the path must carry one of these interruption types. An empty list imposes no requirement.

require-contract-pass.description: When true, the covering control must also have an assurance contract in state pass; a merely declared control does not count.

indeterminate-handling.description: What the gate does with an indeterminate contract, by the impact of the paths it covers. Appendix A.5 requires this choice to be explicit.

maximum-exception-age-days.description: Age at which an exception or not-applicable decision stops counting, measured from its recorded expiry window.

permitted-for-gate.description: When false, a contract whose pass depends on probabilistic inference cannot reach pass; it becomes indeterminate.

require-decision-rule.description: Appendix A.5: probabilistic evidence without an accepted decision rule is indeterminate.

maximum-gating-share.description: Optional ceiling on the fraction of gating contracts that may depend on probabilistic inference.
